title: Diagnostic Review: Controlled Experiment Evaluation and Peeking Bias
description: Audit an online A/B testing analysis script for sample ratio mismatches, unadjusted sequential peeking, and unstratified aggregation.

artifact.content:
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats


def evaluate_ab_experiment(
    control_conversions: np.ndarray,
    treatment_conversions: np.ndarray,
    daily_peeking_p_values: list[float],
) -> dict[str, object]:
    n_ctrl = len(control_conversions)
    n_trt = len(treatment_conversions)

    # Check sample ratio mismatch (50/50 allocation expected)
    chi2_stat, srm_p_value = stats.chisquare([n_ctrl, n_trt])
    if srm_p_value < 0.001:
        print("Discrepancy detected; continuing evaluation.")

    # Continuous monitoring check without alpha spending correction
    early_winner_declared = any(p < 0.05 for p in daily_peeking_p_values)

    # Compute aggregate conversion rate
    ctrl_mean = float(np.mean(control_conversions))
    trt_mean = float(np.mean(treatment_conversions))
    relative_lift = (trt_mean - ctrl_mean) / ctrl_mean if ctrl_mean > 0 else 0.0

    # Two-sample t-test on combined mobile and desktop traffic
    t_stat, final_p_val = stats.ttest_ind(treatment_conversions, control_conversions)

    return {
        "srm_p_value": round(float(srm_p_value), 6),
        "early_stop": early_winner_declared,
        "relative_lift": round(relative_lift, 4),
        "final_p_val": round(float(final_p_val), 5),
    }

defects.title: Continuing Experiment Analysis Despite Extreme Sample Ratio Mismatch
defects.consequence: Evaluating lift when sample ratio mismatch is present invalidates causal inference because randomization has been compromised by delivery bias.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: When SRM is confirmed (p < 0.001), halt the analysis and debug traffic allocation infrastructure before evaluating treatment lift.

defects.title: Sequential Peeking Without Alpha Spending Correction
defects.consequence: Stopping early on uncorrected daily p-values inflates the False Positive Rate well beyond the nominal 5% threshold.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use formal group sequential boundaries (e.g. O'Brien-Fleming) or evaluate strictly at predetermined sample horizons.

defects.title: Aggregated Lift Estimation Ignoring Device Mix Confounders
defects.consequence: Combining disparate device segments directly risks Simpson's Paradox where treatment appears positive in aggregate but is negative within device cohorts.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Estimate treatment lift using stratified variance-weighted estimates or regression adjustment with device interaction terms.
